sourceChanges: New controller-terminal.cjs supplies conservative entry-anchored UTC/process-monotonic/shared-boot deadline, checked operations, remaining-budget Git and immutable pending finalization candidates

run.cjs and run-install.cjs set no successful candidate before source restoration/audit; receipt/manifest/candidate persistence and final handoff checked; partial failures retain new unqualified raw evidence

release.cjs requires all original terminal hashes and same assignment/source/deadline; separately observes original PID/start-tick absent after reading/hashing originals and before UTC/shared-boot expiry
Both250 gates use one strict validator requiring schema4 natural100 candidate, same-source/same-packet and independently reviewed installer+witness terminal proof + native step success
Existing diagnostic workflow forwards native install/witness step outcomes; ordinary recall steps and pinned actions remain identical

staticCounterexamples.sourceDisposition: Each call receives only remaining timeout and post-return check. The third cannot leave an accepted candidate after crossing either deadline.

staticCounterexamples.sourceDisposition: Post-write check rejects; missing finalization candidate plus raw partial holds release.

staticCounterexamples.sourceDisposition: Independent original-birth absence after candidate read/hash cannot be observed before expiry, even if candidate has an earlier pre-write timestamp.
Same shared deadline/candidate/independent terminal proof rules apply; no natural install qualification from a stage alone.

staticCounterexamples.sourceDisposition: Both gates require schema4 exact-packet100 and two complete timely original controller proofs; old or incomplete evidence refuses.
